unavailable.title: The app is not responding
unavailable.intro: Skins Manager could not reach its own local service. Nothing was lost: your data is saved on this computer.

steps.reopen: Close the app and open it again.
steps.bat: If you open it with start-app.bat, close the black window and run start-app.bat again.
steps.restart: If it keeps happening, restart the computer and open the app again.

conflict.FEE_INCONSISTENT: The sale credit in the statement does not match the price minus the fee. Check on CSFloat.

conflict.CHOOSE_UNIT: There is more than one identical unit in stock: use "Link to entry" to choose.
conflict.TARGET_ALREADY_LINKED: That entry is already linked to another CSFloat trade.
conflict.ALREADY_LINKED: This trade is already linked to an entry.
conflict.RECORD_NOT_FOUND: The CSFloat record of this trade no longer exists. Import again.
conflict.CATALOG_NOT_FOUND: The item is no longer in the catalog. Update the catalog and try again.
conflict.UNIT_IN_STOCK: This unit is already in stock. Import again to record the sale on it.

explain.REMOVE: Deletes the purchase or undoes the sale made in the app. Asks for confirmation.
explain.KEEP: Keeps your entry as it is. The app stops warning about this trade.
explain.CREATE: Enters this trade in the app even though it looks like a duplicate.
explain.LINK: Ties this trade to an entry you already made, without creating a new one.
explain.IGNORE: Does nothing for now. You can go back in the Ignored tab.
explain.CREATE_PURCHASE: Enter the store, price and date. The sale is recorded right after.
explain.MARK_WON: Records the item as received, with cost 0, and records the sale.
explain.APPLY_FROM_STOCK: Uses an item from your stock as this weapon's sticker or charm.
explain.REOPEN: Puts the trade back in the review list.

fullScanConfirm.title: Run a full scan?
fullScanConfirm.body: The app will read the whole CSFloat trade history and statement again, without stopping where the last import stopped. This makes more requests and can take up to 2 minutes. Nothing is duplicated: trades already imported are recognized by their ID, and the entries you made yourself keep being linked by float (or by item, price and day). Trades from before the cutoff date ({date}) stay out, so money already in your entries and deposits is not counted twice. To import older trades, change the cutoff date on the Imports page.
fullScanConfirm.componentsNote: The scan also fills in, once, the stickers and charm of purchases already imported. The ones you registered yourself are not changed.
fullScanConfirm.timeNote: It can take a few minutes. Keep the app open.

cutoffChange.title: Change cutoff date
cutoffChange.blockBody: Up to this date, you have already entered everything in the app, or that period's balance is in a deposit. Trades from before it are not imported.
cutoffChange.backwardHelp: Earlier date: the app imports the trades between the new date and the current one. Imported purchases come out of the CSFloat store balance and sales go in. If one of your deposits already covered that period, the money will be counted twice.
cutoffChange.forwardHelp: Later date: nothing already imported is deleted. Trades from before the new date that are not imported yet stop being imported, and the ones to review are closed.
cutoffChange.undoHelp: The change runs a full scan. You can undo it with "Undo import" while it is the latest import that changed something.

csfloatSetup.modalBody: Instead of typing, you can import your purchases, sales, deposits and withdrawals straight from CSFloat.
csfloatSetup.modalHint: To do that, connect CSFloat in Settings. The step-by-step guide is there and takes about a minute.
csfloatSetup.title: How to connect CSFloat
csfloatSetup.step1: Sign in to CSFloat with your Steam account.
csfloatSetup.step2: Open your profile and go to the "Developers" tab.
csfloatSetup.step3: Click "New Key" and copy the key.
csfloatSetup.step4: Paste the key below, click "Save key" and then "Test connection".
csfloatSetup.step5: Click "Import now" (below) or "Import from CSFloat" in the Inventory. Choose the cutoff date: up to when you have already entered everything in the app.
csfloatSetup.safety: The key gives access to your CSFloat account: do not share it with anyone. If it leaks, delete it on CSFloat and create another one.
